requirements.RC-1273: Title, section, body and caption are explicit semantic typography classes.
requirements.RC-1274: The four typography classes are visually distinct by size and/or weight.
requirements.RC-1275: Normal body text uses a readable 16sp baseline and caption/chart labels do not become micro-text.
requirements.RC-1276: Typography classes define baseline line-height values.
requirements.RC-1277: Paragraph spacing is centralized as a semantic token.
requirements.RC-1278: Section spacing is centralized as a semantic token.
requirements.RC-1281: PDF and screen edge padding use an aligned semantic baseline where practical.
requirements.RC-1282: Chart legend and legend-item spacing are standardized.
requirements.RC-1283: Chart label minimum font size is explicit and readable.
requirements.RC-1284: Dark-mode primary and muted text pairs meet WCAG AA normal-text contrast.
requirements.RC-1285: Light-mode primary and muted text pairs meet WCAG AA normal-text contrast.

release_blockers: Production screens, charts and PDF renderer must be audited for full adoption of the semantic tokens.
Rendered TR/EN golden UI/PDF evidence at supported text scales remains required before VERIFIED/DONE.
Accessibility/device and exact release gates remain open.
